_comment: Reviewed exceptions to the house rules in spec section 1. Each entry needs file, rule and the exact offending text, plus a note saying who accepted it and why. Keep this list short: an entry here is a decision, not a snooze.

allow.note: Accepted 29 August. The client's own final copy for the four Insights articles and the listing page uses 28 em dashes. The instruction was that her copy ships verbatim, every word, and copy she has signed off outranks a house style rule we set for the copy we write ourselves. This exception covers her words only: src/content/insights.ts is generated from her files and holds nothing else.

Accepted 1 October (pass 7). Her own words, in "What it actually takes to launch a consumer product in Dubai" (setup costs) and "Why growing businesses in Dubai need a CFO before they think they do" (a CFO's monthly salary), one of the three September articles generated from the page her v3 slide 10 links to. "AED 35,000" is a market figure she cites, not a price Pivot Prime charges, so the pricing rule it trips (the audit floor is the only price on the site) does not apply to it. Her copy ships verbatim. Exact match only, scoped to src/content/insights.ts, which holds nothing but her words. PENDING-COPY 1g3.
